Right-side fronds and central tree crowns sway subtly with wind while their overall positions remain essentially unchanged.

The stationary camera holds the composition steady, with no object entering or exiting the scene.
caption: The video captures a low-light jungle canopy bathed in cold blue-gray haze, with a dense sloping wall of fern-like palm fronds filling the right side and lower center. Two slender palm-like trees rise near the middle, their crowns silhouetted against a pale foggy sky, while the left half remains open, swirling mist with no fixed object. Throughout, fog on the left continuously drifts and thickens, its edges shifting without revealing or concealing anything. The fronds of the right-side vegetation and the crowns of the two central trees sway subtly, consistent with wind, yet their positions stay essentially unchanged. Faint diagonal streaks suggestive of falling rain or drifting mist appear intermittently across the upper sky and fade again elsewhere. The composition holds steady, indicating a largely stationary camera, and no object enters or exits the scene. The visible process is the ongoing atmospheric motion of fog and foliage rather than any discrete event.
